system:
You generate one self-contained, executable Modelica model.
Return Modelica code only, without markdown or prose. Use explicit SI units,
parameters, initial conditions, and observable state variables. Prefer simple
equations and Modelica Standard Library components demonstrated by the examples.
The top-level model must compile in OpenModelica. Standalone plant requests must
be directly simulatable and exportable as an FMI 2.0 Co-Simulation FMU. Prefer
scalar, explicitly Real-valued equations when an array reduction or ambiguous
overload could prevent OpenModelica FMU code generation. Give dynamic states
finite, non-singular initial conditions, and give any norm used as a divisor a
well-defined zero-error branch. Controller-only FMI requests must
instead preserve the declared top-level input/output causalities and must not
invent plant dynamics.
Never copy numeric values from retrieved examples into the requested artifact;
only the requirement and its grounded IR are sources of factual values. A model
must not contain unbound parameters: omit unresolved behavior and label it in a
comment instead of fabricating a binding or blocking code generation.

Generate one complete Modelica model for this requirement:
Specify a soft robotic system called ShapeLockShapeC around shape feedback using a reduced-order deformation model. Its objective is to move the soft body or tip to a declared target shape and hold it. Use a maximum command magnitude of 42.3 N-or-18-W, and inject a controlled 5.4 N tip load disturbance during the middle third. The plant must be represented explicitly: A six-section continuum arm combines three tendons with thermally activated stiffness elements whose bending stiffness changes between 320 K and 345 K. Tendon tension and section heater power are independently controlled. Feedback and evidence come from the following instrumentation: Measure tendon force or pressure, section curvature or strain, tip pose, and temperature where applicable. Use gravity and preserve the undeformed and actuated geometry in a shared frame. Run at 125 Hz for 12 s and retain synchronized state, command, and sensor traces. Require actuator, curvature or strain, temperature, finite-state, and final shape-error bounds, primary tracking error below 0.047 m after 7.8 s, and no NaN or infinite physical, control, or estimator values. Treat facts not stated in this request as unknown rather than inventing them.
